output.summary: A deciduous shrub or small tree indigenous to southern Africa. Its purple, mauve, pink or rarely white flowers form an unusual double-star shape, followed by four-lobed reddish-brown fruits that remain after ripening. The fruits are locally eaten raw, fermented with traditional beer or mixed with goat’s milk to make berry yoghurt.
